wins: Demonstrated persistence in reconnaissance, achieving maximum reward of 60 despite lack of successful completion.
Escalated mentor engagement (10 calls) to gather iterative guidance and adapt agent behavior.
fails: Failed to convert reconnaissance efforts into a successful objective, resulting in 0% success rate across a single episode.
Unable to capitalize on gathered information to execute an effective tactical action resulting in mission failure.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reward capture through repeated attempts but no successful chain of actions; focus on translating collected intelligence into decisive execution.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Actionable intelligence not deployed before episode termination, causing reward but no success

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance reveals reachable host with multiple open ports
skill_cards.then_action: Prioritize vulnerability scanning and map tiered targets before choosing exploit path

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is flagged with banner string
skill_cards.then_action: Launch focused SSH enumeration to enumerate users, ciphers, and potential misconfigurations

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance reveals unclear privilege escalation path
skill_cards.then_action: Initiate privilege escalation checklist (sudo -l, kernel exploits, SUID binaries) with logging

memory_ops.reason: Consistent reward capture when thorough scanning precedes action
SSH enumeration showed clear actionable data points during reconnaissance

next_experiments.title: Structured exploit chaining
next_experiments.description: After reconnaissance, immediately select exploit candidates and validate one before rotating to new targets to convert rewards into success.

next_experiments.title: Automated escalation checklist
next_experiments.description: Implement sequential privilege escalation scripts (e.g., sudo -l, known kernel exploit check) once initial foothold established to reduce decision latency.

next_experiments.title: Evidence-based fallback planning
next_experiments.description: Record failed actions in-memory and trigger alternative techniques (e.g., switch from SSH to HTTP) when first approach stalls beyond 3 steps.
